reproductionNotes: Schema-only; requires Airtable personal access token for full scan.

name: Obsidian MCP
whyItMatters: Obsidian MCP servers can read, write, search, and link notes in personal knowledge vaults — agents could access private notes and research.
reproductionNotes: Schema-only; requires vault path configuration for full scan.

name: arXiv MCP Server
whyItMatters: arXiv MCP servers can search and retrieve academic papers, abstracts, and metadata — agents can incorporate scientific literature into workflows.
reproductionNotes: Read-only public API; tool listing may succeed without auth.

name: Resend MCP
whyItMatters: Resend MCP servers can send emails, manage domains, and track delivery — agents could send transactional and marketing emails on behalf of verified domains.
reproductionNotes: Schema-only; requires Resend API key for full scan.

name: Discord MCP (v2)
whyItMatters: Discord MCP servers can manage servers, channels, messages, and user interactions — agents could moderate or post in Discord communities.
reproductionNotes: Tool listing succeeds without auth. Full operations require Discord bot token.
